description: Checks a board text without publishing it. Returns what the board understood, page by page, and every problem with its line and how to fix it. Fix every ERROR, then call check_board again. When there are no errors, call publish_board.

text.description: The whole board in the Notematics format: # title, :::companion, :::font, :::theme and :::show lines under it, ## pages, Markdown with $...$ formulas and [words]{red highlight} spans, :::graph blocks (curves, points, segment(A, B), line, ray, perp(A, x), on(f, 2), text (x, y) "words"), :::geometry and :::solid blocks, and :::comment, :::say blocks and :::mood, :::show lines and marks (:::strike "+3", :::cancel, :::cross, :::underline, :::double, :::circle, :::box, and :::unmark to rub one out) under ### step headings. The ~~~notematics fence around it is optional.

name: check_board
title: Check a board
